title: The Will to Power: An Attempted Transvaluation of All Values. Book III and IV
summary: "The Will to Power: An Attempted Transvaluation of All Values. Book III and IV" by Friedrich Nietzsche is a compilation of notebook fragments assembled posthumously in the early 1900s.
